title: Localization of the separable algebraic diagonal
statement: Let $k\subseteq k_1$ be a separable algebraic extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There exists a multiplicative subset $S\subseteq k_1\otimes_k k_1$ such that the multiplication homomorphism $\mu:k_1\otimes_k k_1\to k_1$, $a\otimes b\mapsto ab$, identifies $k_1$ with the localization $S^{-1}(k_1\otimes_k k_1)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]; equivalently, $\mu$ is a localization map at $S$ (every element of $S$ maps to a unit of $k_1$; every element of $k_1$ equals $\mu(x)\mu(s)^{-1}$ for some $x\in k_1\otimes_kk_1$ and $s\in S$; and every $x\in k_1\otimes_kk_1$ with $\mu(x)=0$ satisfies $sx=0$ for some $s\in S$).
